Less of a "game" and more of an interactive centerfold, the motion gravure series features video clips of sexy Japanese models in various settings. What makes the clips unique? Each clip is a series of still photos that morph together into one seamless video.

The process makes for very surreal visuals accompanied by an ambient/minimal soundtrack. As each clip progresses, the player is able to zoom in and view things up close. (S)he can also "dog ear" - mark favorite portions for later replay - any portion of the clips.

Five "Secret Shot!" clips are unlockable by pressing the triangle button once a visual cue appears during normal play. Once all five are unlocked, a sixth and final clip is available.

This title features the sexy, Japanese model Mori Hiroko (aka Hiroko Mori in western naming convention).

211501.overview: Mahoroba Stories is an Adventure game, developed and published by Dimple Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2007.

211502.overview: The Destroyer is again walking the land. The legendary Planeswalker Escaton has been seen in Jadame, and the very elements themselves have felt his presence. In the four corners of the world, gates to the planes of Fire, Air, Earth and Water have opened and denizens of those realms are sweeping across the lands, devastating all in their path. Lead a band of rugged adventurers on a most perilous mission to save the kingdoms of ruin or watch as the lands are devastated forever.

211503.overview: Moujuutsukai to Oujisama is an Adventure game, developed by Design Factory and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2010.

211506.overview: Myself; Yourself: Sorezore no Finale is an Adventure game, developed and published by Yeti, which was released in Japan in 2009.

216284.overview: This disc containing Metal Gear and Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake was released as the second disc in the メタルギアソリッド3 20周年廉価版 (lit. Metal Gear Solid Whole Year Low Price Edition) re-release of Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater.

217061.overview: You play as Momo Samejima, a special forces agent. Your mission is to assassinate the leader of an organization that's secretly selling a potent new drug, Perorin. You'll make use of guns and grenades as you sneak into a city and face off against enemies in 3D. The chief draw of the game, even though it promises action-packed excitement, is what the special forces agent is wearing -- a mini-skirt! She tackles thugs with swift kicks in her short, short skirt. She blasts away at goons in her stocking-accessorized, ultra-short China-look dress. She may even have to sashay down guarded hallways in nothing but a bikini, with no mini-skirt on at all!

218343.overview: One day, the heir to the prosperous Kaburagi Corporation, a soft-spoken yet cultured young man, received a visit from his family lawyer. He came to pass on the final wish of the boy's late grandfather: that he attend an all-girls school! With his childhood friend Mariya - a talented fashionista - to help him with the "transition," Mizuho enrolls in his new school. It's not long before a series of strange misunderstandings leads to him being elected the school's "Elder Sister," the idol of the entire student body! It's one wild event after another at this all-girls charm school! Can Mizuho make it through the year with his identity - and his dignity - intact?

218598.overview:
The hack adds the four Vs. Mode characters for selection on Story Mode and skips the Brutality and Multality needed to progress in favor of allowing to play through the entire game with them.

All characters are unlocked by default.

313656.overview: "Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED" (機動戦士ガンダムSEED, MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED) is an action game for PlayStation 2 released by Bandai on July 31, 2003, based on the anime work of the same name.

419298.overview:
Memories Off After Rain is a set of three Japanese romance visual novels developed by KID for the PlayStation 2. They are the sequels to Memories Off and Memories Off 2nd. The game volumes were released for the PlayStation 2 on January 27, 2005.

Divided in three parts, the first one takes place in May, where Tomoya interacts with Yue and the rest of the girls. In the second one, Ken keeps his relationship with Hotaru. And in the last one, Tomoya fails his exams and enters on depression but Ken manages to pass.

The protagonist of the vol.1 story is Tomoya Mikami, a 3rd grade high-school student. When he was in junior high-school, he had a girlfriend called Ayaka Hidzuki. But after she has been involved in a car accident and passed away, he lost touch with the world and became more confined. During his hard time, Yue Imasaka, his childhood friend, has helped him shake off the depressive mood and lifted his spirits and made him start thinking positively again. The two of them became real close and before realizing, they became a couple.

This visual novel if first in the three volume series. About halfway through the game you get to make a choice which takes the story in a certain direction.

419302.overview: Sorekara Again is a direct sequel to Memories Off: Sorekara which takes events during the following days to the original story. Game features three separate stories (so called "after episodes"), each one centering around the time you (Isshuu Sagisawa, the same protagonist from the original story) spent with a different girl, Inori Misasagi, Miyabi Fujiwara and Karin Hanamatsuri. Gameplay itself is pretty much unchanged, the plot changes based on the choices you select during the story.

419545.overview:
Memories Off (メモリーズオフ, Memorīzu Ofu) is a Japanese visual novel developed by KID originally released in Japan on September 30, 1999 for the PlayStation, and was later released for the PC, Dreamcast, PlayStation 2, and the PlayStation Portable. Subsequent versions incorporated new content not found in the original version, such as a second part of the story, Memories Off: Pure, originally released as a separate game for the Neo Geo Pocket Color on April 27, 2000. The gameplay in Memories Off follows a linear plot line, which offers pre-determined scenarios and courses of interaction, and focuses on the appeal of the six female main characters.

Memories Off has made several transitions to other media. A manga anthology was published in August 2000 by Enterbrain. It was followed by an original video animation series produced by E&G Films released on three DVDs and VHSs between November 11, 2001, and March 8, 2002. Three novels and a drama CD were also produced.

This is a Taiwanese and Korean only release, although this game was released in Japan with Memories Off 2nd under the name Memories Off Duet: 1st & 2nd Stories which also contains additional scenarios.

438205.overview:
"Minna no Golf Online" takes the popular Clap Hanz title online. Golfers can play with up to four players on select courses as well as socialize in pre-game lobbies. Avatars can be personalized. A monthly fee applies.

In addition to the main online component, a single or two player mode is also available.

438361.overview:
Mega Man X7: N's Edition is a ROM hack of Mega Man X7, with the goal of overall gameplay improvements. Its extensive feature list includes:

* The enemy's weakness system has been added.
* You can turn the conversation over quickly with the start button.
* The tempo of some event scenes has accelerated.
* Some unnecessary conversations have been deleted.
* The conditions for X to join us have been changed to the rescue of 32 hostages.
* Sound effect and BGM volume have been adjusted.
*Rank promotion conditions have been eased further.
* While axl is transforming, you can release the transformation with the player change button.
* Weapon damage and consumption have been adjusted.
* Some special weapons have been accelerated.

Many more improvements have been added, along with continued updates from the creator of the patch.

438379.overview:
In a dystopian future, civilization crumbles but not all is lost. Survivors set out to recreate the world with ordered and controlled social structures. In the rebuilding process, society requires coordination by corporate decree to keep the peace. The company that is established as the arbiter of the planet's rebuilding is called the Planetary Development Corp which asserts control and starts setting up social strata as well as systems of habitation. White collar workers are groomed to work at the corporation where they handle the development and growth of the world. Even under the auspices of an efficiently managed system, a religious rebel force rises to raise a ruckus.

As a new employee of the Planetary Development Corporation, Houjou Minagi works with fellow workers to address eruptions of unrest and squash disturbances. Houjou collaborates with a bubbly office girl named Mizuha Sakura and a new employee named Karen Asagiri to support the infrastructure of the corporate machine. One day, a wandering girl named Larissa enters Minagai's life and he resolves to help her recover her memory as well as tie-in her connection to a mercenary killer named Metal Wolf. Essentially a hentai game, Metal Wolf features suggestive poses, lewd panty shots, and other adult themes which thread through the game.

439116.overview: The Maestromusic II (known in Japan as ザ・マエストロムジーク ツヴァイ) is a classical music conductor simulation game released exclusively for the Sony PlayStation 2 in Japan. Developed and published by Global A Entertainment, the game was launched on August 2, 2001. It served as a sequel to the original PlayStation 1 entries, upgrading the experience with a flashier user interface designed for the PS2 hardware.

439851.overview: Kyo-no Wanko is a Strategy game, developed by Infinity and published by DigiCube, which was released in Japan in 2003.

440320.overview: Mahjong Haoh: Shinken Battle is a Miscellaneous game, published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2004.

440321.overview: Mahjong Sangokushi is a Miscellaneous game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2004.

440322.overview: Mahjong Hiryu Densetsu: Tenpai is a Miscellaneous game, published by Nippon Telenet, which was released in Japan in 2003.

440323.overview: Mahjong is a Miscellaneous game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

440325.overview:
Magical Tale - Chitchana Mahoutsukai: A port of a PC game. Is a love/adventure game where a curse transforms you into a kid and you search for the magician who cast the spell. This premise is of course wrapped into the genre-typical school seeting. On his quest, the player attends magic school and deepen his relationship with six girls.

In this love simulation, you play as Lucian, a student at a magic school who's been transformed by curse into younger form and must now attend classes with young girls. As you attend class, you'll get to know eight personable heroines via interactive conversations and event scenes.

The game's limited edition includes an original drama CD (8190 yen). Character designs are by Teinkuru.

440326.overview: Mahjong Haoh: Dankyuu Battle II is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2006.

440328.overview: Mahjong Haou: Kaikyuu Battle is a Miscellaneous game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2002.

440336.overview: Mahjong Haou: Taikai Battle is a Miscellaneous game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2003.

440349.overview:
Ma-Gi - Marginal: Shio lost his parents when he was young and lived with his grandfather since then. When he is at border of death, he gives Shio the key to a house located in a village and tells him that he has the right to choose if he wants to live there. Thus, he goes to the village thinking that the house is abandoned, but he finds that five maids live there. Soon, another maid who came from the woods joins them. Shio starts living with them at the house and thus, his new life begins...

When the protagonist in Merge Marginal loses both parents in a tragic accident, grandpa's home is opened to him. When gramps himself passes on, he leaves the mansion to the player who must maintain the estate with a staff of six girls (Merge Feuerbach, Ameria Phosrylase, Erika Brown, Fin Tonnies, Phoneme Tonnies-daughter of Fin, and Konoha Minashiro). Perhaps the hero will find happiness with one of the girls and escape the specter of death that has trailed him since the outset of the game.

From the piano ditty to the theme song that plays during the intro to Merge, one gets the impression that Marginal is a highly polished affair. The introduction names the girls in the game and shows a few of them seemingly casting magic spells - or at least one of them is doing something with a pentagram.

Arriving at the gates of grandpa's manse, a lovely maid named Fin Tonnies introduced herself and our character buried himself into her bosom in an overly friendly embrace. The game interface consists of a VCR-like mini-menu where conversations may be fast-forwarded or simply played in normal speed. After Fin opens up the gates to the mansion (to a lot of creaking and shrieking metal), the player meets Merge Feuerbach and the fiery tempered Phoneme Tonnies who lays the smackdown in the early moments of our first meeting...

440350.overview: Mageru Tsukeru Hahiiru - Ore * Dead Heat: is a racing contruction game in which his seven different editors the player can design the circuits and the different cars parts. But also the player can design the enemy vehicles, and even the game story. The game also got some already made story modes in which the player can drive the car and advance through the game's plot.

440352.overview: Mahjong Haoh Battle Royale is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2005.

440353.overview: Mahjong Haou: Jansou Battle is a Miscellaneous game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2001.

440378.overview:
The series focuses on Neuro Nogami, a demon who eats mysteries. Because he has already eaten every mystery in the demon world, he comes to the human world to feast on the mysteries offered by humans (who release negative energy from their planned crimes). As a demon, he does not wish to make his presence in the human world widely known. Because of this, he makes a deal with a 16-year-old high school girl Yako Katsuragi, who wants to solve her father's murder mystery that was declared a suicide by the police. They establish a detective agency and together with Shinobu Godai, a former criminal, and Akane, a sentient braid of hair, they solve crimes to feed Neuro's appetite. As they solve more cases, Yako becomes a popular detective in Japan, attracting even more criminal's attention.

Majin Tantei Nougami Neuro: Battle Da Yo! Hannin Shugo!, a PlayStation 2 game, was also released in August 28, 2008. The game is an adventure game with some action parts, the game is divided into chapters and during each chapter the game is played in a first person adventure part and the player can only choose between some possible answers to advance in the game and at the end of each part there is an enemy sequence (one on one fight, rpg battle, etc) in those part the game is action orientated and the player can control the character or select the actions to defeat the enemy.

440379.overview:
Majokko a la Mode is an adventure game with mini games that takes place in the Mint Kingdom, there's a magic school called "Twinkle Academy". There, an exam is made on summer that the students take to test their magical habilities. However, this year the exam will be made in pairs... and you need a partner! You need to pursue one of the six heroines so you can do the exam... and maybe something else!

Majokko à la mode II - Hikari to Yami no Étranger (aka Majommusume A La Mode II) is the second game in the series and is also a visual novel that is a port of a PC title adding two new characters. The gameplay is divided into 3 different parts, the classic adventure part with different choices in the election points, the magic synthesis part in which the player can combine magic to create new ones, and the combat mode in which the player and his parts can go battle enemies using the magic created in the magic synthesis part.

440382.overview:
Majokko a la Mode is an adventure game with mini games that takes place in the Mint Kingdom, there's a magic school called "Twinkle Academy". There, an exam is made on summer that the students take to test their magical habilities. However, this year the exam will be made in pairs... and you need a partner! You need to pursue one of the six heroines so you can do the exam... and maybe something else!

The Limited Magical Box Edition was released in a box that contains the game, and magical illustration book & the CD Twinkle Academy Mint Kingdom 666.

440383.overview: Makai Tensho is an dungeon-crawler RPG based on the 1967 novel of the same title by Futaro Yamada. Similar to Chunsoft's Mysterious Dungeon series, the player controls the hero Yagyu Jubei through randomly-generated floors, which are filled with enemies, items, and traps, searching for the exit and attempting to survive. Movement and actions are turn-based, with all enemies taking a turn at the same time as the player. Weapons will degrade with use, though new ones of varying types can be found within the dungeons. After clearing a certain number of floors, the player reaches a village, where they may rest and save.

440405.overview: Marble Chaos is a Puzzle game, developed and published by Phoenix Games, which was released in Europe in 2007.

440412.overview: The title is a mini-game with TV anime "MamiMume Mogacho" theme. Some of the game output as well as its characters' cards can be printer on a popegg printer (PS2 compatible printer).

440413.overview: Manea Sugoroku: Kabukuro is a Strategy game, developed and published by Ertain, which was released in Japan in 2007.

440414.overview:
Unlike the formula of most visual novels, which are noted for their minimal interaction, Maple Colors is slightly different in that it combines elements of an adventure game with that of interactive fiction. Though reasonably limited, players control chibi versions of characters, able to travel around isometric maps, perform tasks, collect items and even participate in mini-games. In a more recognizable fashion, players watch and listen to sequences of story and then select choosable actions or responses when they are presented. As choices are intricately linked to alternating routes of plot, the direction of the story is changed, leading to erotic scenes between characters and ultimately one of various endings. In order for the player to watch all the possible endings in this regard, he or she will have to effectively replay through the game several times, all the while making different selections.

The Playstation 2 version removes the erotic content of the game.

440504.overview:
Ever mischievous and trouble making, Loki is banished from Asgard to Middle Earth where he incarnates as a little brown-haired, green-eyed child. The condition for his return to the company of the Aesir is the capture of evil spirits on 'ol Midgard. To this end, Loki establishes the Enjaku Detective Agency which takes on supernatural assignments that have a greater likelihood of encountering discarnate spirits.

Teamed with a rambunctious pink-haired girl named Mayura Daidouji and his son Ryuusuke Yamino (aka The Midgard Serpent), the Enjaku Detective Agency is retained for a new scenario that was written especially for the PS2 game. Loki's other children, Fenrir and Hel, accompany their father in the respective forms of a black dog and a little girl. The god of thunder, Thor, provides comic relief in the form of a lad named Narugami who has forgotten the way back to Asgard.

As the story goes, paintings by a famous artist are disappearing and the Enjaku Detective Agency is retained to sniff out the culprit. Arriving at the gallery one evening, Loki and the gang launch an investigation and soon discover that things are not as they seem...

440506.overview:
In the near future, computer and AI technology has advanced to the point where robots and androids live and work alongside humans. However, while war has all but ended, terrorism is on the rise, and in particular, there have been an increasing amount of robot uprisings in recent years. To combat this threat, the government has established strict regulations forbidding any robots capable of emotion.

Yuna Fubuki is the newest intern at Arion Medical Center, a prestigious and advanced medical facility. However, Yuna has a secret: she's actually a highly-advanced android built to be indistinguishable from a real human. She has come to AMC along with her creator, robotics prodigy Souji Saegusa, to put her abilities to the test. She must train and work as a nurse for three months without anyone discovering that she is not actually human. However, AMC holds its own share of dark secrets, and things aren't going to be simple for Yuna.

Medical 91 is a Japanese-style visual novel. The majority of the game is spent reading and listening to the story unfold, though Yuna will often be given choices that will cause the story to branch in varying ways. At many points, it is possible to move freely throughout the hospital to speak with the other characters on numerous subjects, with the story only proceeding once the proper conversations have taken place. There are also certain segments where the player must choose locations to escape pursuit, as well as avoid capture in a timing-based minigame.

440507.overview:
Medical and Engineering Joint Entrance Quiz is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Candela Software and published by SCEE, which was released in Asia in 2009.

This game was created to target the vast student community in India, with 2 new India based quiz games Developed by Bangalore-based game development studio – Candella.

440515.overview:
Classic games volume 1 is packed with 10 retro style arcade games. Whether you're a retro junkie or simply enjoy great gameplay you're guaranteed hours of classic gaming action... They're addictive!!
Included games: Invaders, Loop the Loop, Dragon Tiles 3, Bounty Hunter X, Chopper 2, Jet Pack 2, Paddle Panic, Pop 'Em, Proxima, Super Power Shot

440522.overview:
Combat-heavy racer from developer Supersonic, played from a top-down perspective. Mashed features four players racing at one time either in teams of two or every man for himself. The 13 different race environments are spread over various terrain including ice, sand and highways. An assortment of weapons are used to batter opponents into submission and gain rank in the race. However, once another car is blasted off road the player will still be able to target the race leader with air missile strikes.

A re-mastered version titled Mashed: Fully Loaded was released later with more features. This release also served as the version that was released in North America and Japan as Drive to Survive.

440647.overview:
The story follows the lives of students at an elite academy of the fictional European country of Kuchen in 1937.
Other adaptations consist of a 4 volume Meine Liebe manga and a novel. Also, several drama CDs have been released.

Produced by Hirotaka Reizei, Meine Liebe - Yuubinaru Kioku is a love simulation game based on the Game Boy Advance hit. The year is 1935. Set in the beautiful kingdom of Kuchen, in the Rosenschutz School, the player assumes the role of a young girl with an eye for love. Gameplay covers two years in the school and is mainly communication based, much like other games in this genre. Konami prides itself on gorgeous character art and the addition of unique filters and camera angles. The game utilizes a LoveLove Filter, a MellowMellow Filter, and the Dramatical Eye System to bring the game's young cast to life. "Meine Liebe" is German and translates to "My Love."

440651.overview:
Meine Liebe II - Hokori to Seigi to Ai: is the second love simulation game based on the Game Boy Advance hit, again following a group of young girls with an eye for love of the game's gorgeous boys. The first Meine Liebe game was a simulation, but for the sequel, Konami has delivered a boys love adventure game. The focus this time around is on the story, with the cast from the original, including sub-characters, returning as heroes. They're joined by three original characters. Your path through the story changes depending on the lines you select during dialogue sequences.

The Strahl candidates are enjoying a brief holdiay in their various homes. However, many surprises await them when they finally come back to their elite boarding school: Rosenstolz Academy. There is a new headmaster, and his policies are not necessarily to the advantage of the main characters.

The five Strahl candidates return to their final year in Rosenstolz, but troubles are far from over. The previous headmaster disappears without saying a word and the new headmaster has a revolutionary idea that threatens to tear the academy apart. But there are troubles not only inside the academy. The king is hiding information, Lui’s mother is depressed and Lui himself is being accused of severe treason. While on the run Orphe is nearly shot once again, and Ed finds out that figures from their past have once again arrived at Kuchen. Now the five of them must prove Lui’s innocence while stopping a hideous ploy to sell Kuchen to foreign hands.

441240.overview:
Memorial Song is a romance game from Datam, in the game the player will meet up to five girls (one of which looks suspiciously like an older and wiser version of Roommate Ryouko) and interact with them. The gist is this: Songs evoke memories as well as feelings. Couples have their songs and weddings have theme songs - "From this Moment" has probably been played at millions upon millions of nuptials. Each girl in the game has a special song and the music plays a part in the interaction whether it be karaoke or a career path.

The game, which will focus on music, features five heroines: Hinata Yugi lives next door to the main character, Chinatsu Kawamoto is a classmate, Nao Mizushima a sempei, Eri Takizawa a waitress of the family restaurant where the hero works, and Yurina Shiroishi, a girl, whom the protagonist meets by chance when he rides the train home from school. Each of the girls will have a story song of her own.

441260.overview:
Memories Off After Rain is a set of three Japanese romance visual novels developed by KID for the PlayStation 2. They are the sequels to Memories Off and Memories Off 2nd. The game volumes were released for the PlayStation 2 on January 27, 2005.

Divided in three parts, the first one takes place in May, where Tomoya interacts with Yue and the rest of the girls. In the second one, Ken keeps his relationship with Hotaru. And in the last one, Tomoya fails his exams and enters on depression but Ken manages to pass.

Song birds twitter and warble about the arrival of spring and high school seniors start to prepare for graduation. As the third volume of Memories Off After Rain starts, two students are conflicted - Takeshi is an ace student but finds little joy in school and wonders if college is in the cards. Satoru on the other hand has failed the college entrance exams a few times and prospects are looking dim. Can the two students find each other and help the other reach graduation day with brighter prospects/attitudes/outlooks?

Final chapter in the After Rain trilogy. The story continues on the previous two games, but this times features two protagonists. One scenario follows the story of Tomoya from first volume, and the other follow's Ken's story as the graduation time approaches. The story tells the events around the time of graduation, their passing and/or failing to graduate, and the paths they take in comparison to that of their girlfriends.

The gameplay remains similar to the first two volumes in the trilogy.

441261.overview:
Inori was looking forward to go to the annual Ashikajima Fireworks Display with Isshu this summer. They had made a promise to always go to the fireworks festival together, since that was the place that they orginally became a couple. But Isshu said he wouldn't able to go because of his part time job. That day would fall on their two year anniversary. Inori went alone to their memorable place, the church... and she began to recall the previous two years.

Fourth game in the Memories Off series (subtitled "Kakeganai Omoi wo Norikoete"). It takes place one year and a half after Omoide ni Kawaru Kimi ~Memories Off~

441262.overview:
MEMORIES OFF 5: ENCORE is the sequel to Memories Off 5 and was released on July 12, 2007 for the PlayStation 2. The limited edition PlayStation 2 release included a soundtrack for the game. The scenarios for Encore were written by Masashi Takimoto, Naotaka Hayashi, and Haruhisa Kujira. The music for Encore was composed by Takeshi Abo who also composed the music for Memories Off 5. Encore, and 12Riven, another game that was under development by KID, was originally in danger of not being released after KID filed for bankruptcy in 2006. However, both games were resurrected after CyberFront purchased KID's intellectual properties in 2007.

The game was later ported to the PlayStation Portable and was released on September 17, 2009. For the PlayStation Portable's limited edition, a postcard set and a drama CD was included. The PlayStation Portable release of Encore includes screen capture feature that allows the player to save images onto a memory stick.

Encore introduces a new character named Akina Ichijo (voiced by: Minori Chihara). She comes in contact with the main characters after bumping into Kazuki Mishima at a video rental store. The character designs for Akina was done by Yukihiro Matsuo. Encore takes place in December, about half a year after the events of Memories Off 5, and ends in the following February. In this game, the player is able to experience the story from different perspectives besides that of Haruto Kawai. Encore also only focuses on three heroines whereas previous titles in the Memories Off series tended to feature four to six heroines.

441263.overview: Mesaze! Super Hustler!! is a Miscellaneous game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2005.

441264.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.122 - The Ningyo Hime Monogatari - Mermaid Prism is a japanese dating sim, this female-targeted love simulation puts players in the role of a high school student that one day gets warped to a separate world, becoming a mermaid along the way! Good thing she was a member of her school's swimming club! The game allows players to move around on a map, viewing events and gaining experience.

The Limited Edition features a Drama CD, 28 pages book and some illustrations.

441265.overview: Mesaze! Super Bowler is a Sports game, developed and published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2005.

441269.overview:
Memories Off After Rain is a set of three Japanese romance visual novels developed by KID for the PlayStation 2. They are the sequels to Memories Off and Memories Off 2nd. The game volumes were released for the PlayStation 2 on January 27, 2005.

Divided in three parts, the first one takes place in May, where Tomoya interacts with Yue and the rest of the girls. In the second one, Ken keeps his relationship with Hotaru. And in the last one, Tomoya fails his exams and enters on depression but Ken manages to pass.

Second volume in the After Rain trilogy. This time, the protagonist of the story is Ken Inami, a 3rd grade student of a Hamasaki high-school. He has overcome a rough patch in a relationship with his girlfriend, Hotaru Shirakawa. But in his mind, the memories from that summer are still keeping him pondering. The game puts focus on Ken's and Hotaru's relationship from summer time to autumn's school festival.

Gameplay works identically as in first volume, allowing you to affect the story by selecting choices when they present themselves during the plot.

441271.overview:
Memories Off is the title of a series of Japanese romance visual novel video games released by KID. The first game in the series, simply called Memories Off, was released in 1999 for the PlayStation. Memories Off titles have been released on the PC as well as video and handheld gaming consoles such as the PlayStation 2, Dreamcast, WonderSwan Color, and the PlayStation Portable. Several of the series' games' story have been adapted into original video animations, novels, or manga.

Memories Off Mix is a bit off the usual games from the series. While the game has a story mode, it also features many different puzzle games that require thinking and speed.

In the story mode, you play as Shin Inaho. One day, a girl figure appears in front of you. She introduces herself as Ayaka. However, she does not appear to be an ordinary girl. Nobody except Shin can see her, and she cannot go home until she gets "angel wings", so she is stuck here for the moment. Shin and Ayaka decide together to look for angel wings that she needs.

Aside from story mode, there are several different games which include memory game, 4x4 square 15 tile picture assembling puzzles, battle puzzles, speed competition card game, and multiple-answers quiz game relating to Memories Off and Memories Off 2nd.

441273.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.098 - The Roman Sabou: In the game the player takes the role of the only daughter of a family that will have to run a sweet shop during a year of time. The game features over 884 different sweets to make. During the game the player will go with one of the 6 different boys to different places around the town to look for new ingredients for the different sweets, and also check often the balance of the money's shop since if there are loses at the end of any of the months is game over.

If the player got enough money he can improve the sweet shop buying a new one, go to the town's shop to buy new ingredients and also make new recipes combining three different ingredients.

441287.overview: Shio is busy preparing for the school festival. In the morning, when he opens a door to wake Ririsu, his old friend, up as usual, she is still asleep. He tries to wake her up, but she gives him a strong kick... On their way to school, Shio thinks, "Ririsu used to be pretty..." She is, however, now an egoistic girl... One day, Ririsu suddenly introduces Chisa to Shio. "Will you please dance with me at the school festival...?" Shio is confused what to say while Ririsu shows mixed feelings...

441289.overview:
Memories Off Duet is a compilation package contains: Memories Off game, Memories Off: Pure game, Memories Off 2nd game.

The player plays as Ken Inami, a 17 year old junior high-school student. Ken has his dreams and aspirations and would want to go to a film school. His girlfriend, Hotaru Shirakawa, is more interested in music and would like to go to a music school. They've been dating for a while, and while they thought it may last forever, their relationship hit a bump and is hanging by a thread. As Ken, you can try and save your relationship, or break up and chase after another girl. Game features many different endings, depending on the girl you end up with... or if it's the bad ending, the girl you break up in the end.

The game consists of reading text and dialogues over the background images, similar to other visual novels, with occasional choices that may branch the story. For replays, gave features fast-forward option that lets you skipped through previously read events.

441290.overview:
The player takes on the role of Haruto Kawai, the protagonist of Memories Off 5. Haruto is a university student and a member of the Chihaya University Movie (CUM) society (Chihaya University Movie). Yusuke Hina is a close friend of Haruto's. He was in the process of completing the planning for a film he thought of when he died in an accident one year prior to the events of the game. Asuka Hina is a senior high school student and the sister of Yusuke. Mahiro Sendo (???? Sendo Mahiro?, voiced by: Nana Inoue) is an acquaintance of Yusuke's and is at odds with Haruto and the other members of the CUM society as she claims to be responsible for Yusuke's death.

Kazuki Mishima is a friend of Haruto's and is a member of the CUM society. Shuji Ozu is another friend of Haruto's and is also a member of the CUM society. He has feelings for Asuka. Ayumu Kise is a new member of the CUM society and also a character from Memories Off: Sorekara, the previous game in the Memories Off series. Miumi Sawarabi is a cousin of Haruto's who also happens to be a classmate and close friend of Asuka's. Mizuho Amamiya is the manager of the fast food restaurant that Haruto and Asuka works at. Shin Inaho is Haruto's neighbour.

Memories Off 5 was first released for the PlayStation 2 in regular and limited editions on October 27, 2005. The limited edition includes a special book and an original drama CD.

441291.overview:
Men at Work! 3: Hidden in a forest in Europe sits an old castle that has stood there for over 1000 years and inside this castle lays a magic school. Both wizards and monster hunters in training attend this institution. In the previous installments you’re either playing as these very monster hunters and spell casters, or attending magic school like the current game. In this game you play as a son of a well established Crichton family.

However, despite your potent lineage you’re aptitude has been measured to be one of the lowest possible. Regardless, you’re still admitted to the school (along with two friends who’re twin-sisters). Suddenly on the way to the school, the train you all were riding suddenly becomes derailed. It is night and monsters lurk--will the batch of new students get to the castle safe and sound?

You play as Lyle Einsworth, who was born with the special ability to be a magic hunter. During the day, you take classes, speaking with your fellow students and your teachers and exchanging items. You have a set schedule of classes, and by attending classes (making sure not to be late), you can make Lyle's statistics rise. Once the clocks turn nine, the monster hunting beings. You wander the school grounds with your fellow classmates and face off against enemies. Characters in your party have elemental abilities, and by lining up your attacks properly, you can perform combos.

The gameplay is in most part a visual novel in which the player can only choose between different possible answers to advance in the story but in some parts the game changes to a turn based classic rpg in which the player can stop the battle to give orders to his players (like attack, use magic, use items, defend) with the new system that at any time each of the characters can be moved to a later battletime position to join other characters to perform a combo attack.

The Limited Edition features and a illustration booklet draw by Yamamoto Kazue and also included a special music CD.

441324.overview: Mezase! Chess Champion is a Miscellaneous game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2004.

441325.overview: Mezase! Meimon Yakyuubu 2 is a Sports game, developed by Nexus Interact and published by Dazz, which was released in Japan in 2001.

441332.overview: In Monochrome, you play as a character called Taiki Kirioka, who's lost his memory. The story begins when you meet Yun, an angel in training. You experience life with Yun as you attend classes at Kirikaoka Gakuen and develop a relationship with a cast of girls from the school. Gameplay involves selecting your path at various points in the game, with the storyline at times switches to the perspective of the heroines. Also sold as a special limited first run edition that includes a BGM collection and illustration collection.

441340.overview:
Miko mai - Eien no Omoi is a visual novel in which the player is visiting his childhood village (it'll be his last chance because the rail lines to it are about to be discontinued for good). The hotel screws up his reservation, but fortunately Natsuki, his childhood friend (and one of four possible love interests) invites him to stay at the shrine where she works, and thus the story begins as he realizes not all is as happy as it appears.

A Japanese love simulation game, the game's name translates to Miko Mai: Eternal Thoughts and is about a character who, following ten years of separation, returns to his home town and gets entangled with a group of hot priestesses who are screaming for love.

The later released PS2 version includes new events and scenarios not found in the PC version.

441342.overview: Million God is a Miscellaneous game, published by Nippon Amuse, which was released in Japan in 2002.

441346.overview:
Missing Parts Side B - The Tantei Stories is an adventure game released first for the Dreamcast console and later in Playstation 2 with a new control system, A CG gallery & enhanced graphics. Also in the Side B game there is an unlockable bonus story that can be played after complete the 3 episodes. In Playstation 2 the game is divided into 2 different games called Side A & Side B. The game was later ported to PSP with the name of Missing Parts - The Tantei Stories Complete.

Each of the Playstation 2 games got 3 episodes.

Standard interactive gaming interface allows for character conversations and a number of camera functions give players the power of zoom, viewpoint shifting and panning. Play through three sleuthing scenarios which are separately contained chapters but are also intertwined somehow. Unlockable modes in the game include a CG gallery and a BGM mode.

The games plot is about Kyosuke Magami working at the Narumi detective agency. Daughter of Seiji Narumi disappeared and Magami has to find her. But this is one of the part of the big story! Magami going to find more mysterious things behind the original reason of the disappear.

441349.overview:
At Seiryou high school, second year student Masamura Kouji leads a stready, but busy life, alongside with humble and quiet childhood friend Ritsuki Saya and senior student Nishizuku Ruuna.

One day, a transfer student, Kasuga Mizuki, appears and hands over a mysterious crystal while uttering enigmatic words : "Please remember...". While being certain the two of them never met, the main protagonist feels they somehow did. A peculiar connection ?

As a sophomore in high school, a special transfer student goes to the player's class and hands him a strange crystal. Thus begins this digital novel which seeks interactive support from the player.

The first limited edition of Missing Blue ships in a shiny box and includes a postcard-sized calendar & 9 trading cards.

441352.overview:
Missing Parts Side A - The Tantei Stories is an adventure game released first for the Dreamcast console and later in Playstation 2 with a new control system, A CG gallery & enhanced graphics. Also in the Side B game there is an unlockable bonus story that can be played after complete the 3 episodes. In Playstation 2 the game is divided into 2 different games called Side A & Side B. The game was later ported to PSP with the name of Missing Parts - The Tantei Stories Complete.

Each of the Playstation 2 games got 3 episodes.

Standard interactive gaming interface allows for character conversations and a number of camera functions give players the power of zoom, viewpoint shifting and panning. Play through three sleuthing scenarios which are separately contained chapters but are also intertwined somehow. Unlockable modes in the game include a CG gallery and a BGM mode.

The games plot is about Kyosuke Magami working at the Narumi detective agency. Daughter of Seiji Narumi disappeared and Magami has to find her. But this is one of the part of the big story! Magami going to find more mysterious things behind the original reason of the disappear.

441369.overview:
Mizu no Senritsu 2 - Hi no Kioku: You take control of Kira (name changeable), and examine mysterious cases happening around you with a sword. Text reading style is remained, and "Battle Mode" is newly added. Characters from the previous product also appear, including Hina.

The game takes place 2 years after the events of the 1st game. It’s time for more adventures in the town of Showajou. This time, our story centers around Kashiwagi Kira a girl who grew up in an orphanage together with good ol’ Tezuka (and would suffer from having a crush on the bloke).

One day, while asked to accompany ‘Kyou-nii’ to the hotel his parents had died she discovers a mysterious sword (aka Blade of Ashura) hidden in a shrine as suddenly an odd tatoo would appear on her right hand.

The gameplay in the battles the battle icon looks like an ‘outer-circle’ spinning at a pretty high-speed while the player has to press a button to either attack (green triangle), counter (red circle) or defend (purple square). What you press (and the timing) would then decide on what happens.

The Limited Edition includes a drama CD and an illustration book.

441370.overview: Moe Moe 2-ji Daisenryaku Deluxe is a Strategy game, developed and published by SystemSoft, which was released in Japan in 2008.

441372.overview: Kenji is living with his adopted sister Yuki, who admires her older brother and harbors a slight secret crush on him. One day, after a certain night, a girl - Hiyori, their childhood friend - begin to appear in Kenji's closet. Moreover, her body is transparent, and she has gaps in her memory. As they struggle to figure out the mystery behind Hiyori's state, Kenji begins to realize his forgotten feelings and Yuki suffers with her secret.

441374.overview:
Monster Bass: In this game the freshness of the lure can affect the rate of success to catch a fish. Each fish has three status gauges: revitalization, caution and hungry. You can verify the status of each fish before catching it. Monster Bass support both dual shock 2 controller and the fishing rod controller.

The game features 5 different characters (3 male & 2 female ones) and different fishing spots.

441375.overview:
Motto Golful Golf: Well manicured courses, tastefully arranged trees and diligently cored greens enhance the game for any golfing addict. Artdink supplies a visually supple environment in which to exercise your virtual swing but they also enhance the game with a new-type control scheme.

Doing away with golf gaming systems which rely on watching gauges and pressing buttons at opportune moments, Golful gives you total control over your swing by way of tugging and wagging the Dual Shock knobs. It's a more intuitive feel than eyeballing a swing gauge and pounding a button. Thanks to the pressure sensitive nature of the PS2 controllers, exerting more force on the knob imparts greater power to your swing onscreen.

Players may choose from six main characters and develop attributes by going through the 4 courses (Green Park, Lake Land, Grand Mountain & Big Wind). As you hone your game, your character stats improve which allow for better control and power.

The game is the sequel of Golful Golf (Called Mr Golf in Europe).

441385.overview:
Houjou Academy has a special class that only rich students enroll in called the Kuge course. It has a special system where guys can be a 'MASTER' and have another student from the normal classes called a 'HONEY' support them until they graduate.
There are also special students that just oversee the MASTER, HONEY system.
The protagonist Shiratsume Kurumi is a new transfer student who was unaware of the special system.
She is quickly nominated into becoming a HONEY by two of the special students.

441389.overview:
Mizu no Senritsu: Hina Shiraishi, a second-year schoolgirl, one day finds strange incidents happening to her, from being pushed down the stairs to having wild dogs attack her. At night, a mysterious elderly woman speaks to her in her dreams. Hina soon finds herself caught in a war between two supernatural human races.

After 10 years of absence, our heroine Shiraishi Hina returns to the town she grew up as a child thanks to her parents deciding to live overseas. Little did she know that along with the happy reunion with childhood, what awaited her was odd incidents and someone suddenly targeting her life. Katase? Ichiyou? The clan of Kusou? Suddenly Hina is forced to face facts she may have never wanted to deal with, when the coincidence of it always raining whenever she felt sad or depressed turns out to be not as un-related to her.

The Limited Edition includes a prologue drama CD "Mizu no Senritsu - Prelude".

441394.overview: The title follows Takahiro, an enigmatic man served unquestioningly by five beautiful maids with equally mysterious pasts tied to his. Primarily set within a secluded mansion estate, the story is a combination of humor, romance, and surprisingly dark violence; all revealing the exact nature of their association and shared questionable future. The game features three distinct styles of high quality artwork: a tradition style for storytelling, a super-deformed style for comedic events, and a blood red gothic style for the darker moments.

441401.overview:
The story revolves around the high school student Akira Nikaido, a typical slacker living a normal life. That is, until he meets the mysterious Shirogane, a man who suddenly appears and tells him that they have a destiny together. When Akira hears this, he is shocked and doesn't believe a word of it. Suzuno Aya, a friend of Akira, forgets something in the school one night, and asks Akira and Kengo to help her and go find it.

He agrees, and while there, he gets attacked by a shadow monster. Shirogane convinces him that the balance between the human world and the shadow world has been distorted and that Akira must become a "shin"- a creature of the shadow world- in order to help restore the balance. But if Akira stays as a "shin" he will become a shadow himself, and normal people will not see him any more. Shirogane wanted to be with him and lied that if he became his shadow he will be seen by other people again.

A video game of Monochrome Factor for the PlayStation 2 was released on November 27, 2008 called Monochrome Factor Cross Road. It is a visual novel game and will encompass new characters.

The Limited Edition was released in a box that features the game, a soundtrack cd and a doll.

441476.overview:
The game contains three sections for each character.
The first is another story where Tiana picks who she will go to the ball at Kurt’s castle with.
The second is the after story, which is the main dish of the game that continues after the first game’s ending for each guy (but before the epilogues).
Lastly there are bonus extras for each character called “diaries” where you get to see cute scenes that happened “during the last game” and you also get to pet (and now tickle) your favorite furry friends.

441511.overview: Morita Shogi for the PlayStation 2 is a traditional Japanese chess digital board game released exclusively in Japan on 4 March 2000. Developed and published by Yuki Enterprise (with initial system entries associated with ASCII), it stands out as one of the launch-era titles for the console that showcased advanced AI capabilities.

441518.overview: My Merry May: Released also for the Dreamcast console this VN tells the story of Yasusuke, a senior high school student, who lives a normal student's life until one day he receives a strange device from abroad. This device creates Reu, an artifical human being in form of a young girl, who loves Yasusuke and cats. The remaining cast of heroines include Hitoe Haruna, Yasusuke's childhood friend, Motomi Agatsuma, the girlfriend of Yasusuke's nemesis Ryo Hagimoto, 21-year old Tae Kiduki and 13-year old high school student Misao Yuki.

441529.overview: My Merry May with be includes both original love simulations, My Merry May and My Merry Maybe, along with a new scenario and newly drawn visuals. The theme of the game, centering on your relationship with an artificial life form called Replice, remains the same.

441538.overview: My Merry May Be: This game is the sequel to My Merry May. Life in a small town is fairly boring especially when fishing and farming are the main sources of livelihood. As an assistant teacher on your way to becoming a full-fledged educator, you also enjoy a quiet life marked by routine. One day, fate changes your life when you find a beautiful young girl who has been involved in an accident. When she wakes up, her memory has been lost and it is then that you discover that she is an artifical human.

441547.overview: Mutsuboshi Kirari Hoshifuru Miyako (aka Mutsuzaki Hoshi Kikari) is a visual novel videogame that tells the story of a young boy (Tomoki Shinonome) that at the beginning of the game is saying goodbye to his childhood girlfriend Subaru Hoshimi, and some time after he returns to his hometown and start in a new school, In his new school he joins the astronomical club (that is his passion since he was a child) when he meets other girls and Subaru Hoshimi again.

441549.overview:
My Home o Tsukurou! 2: In this simulation, you create a home of your own, setting up room layouts on a grid using a simple input system. Compared to the previous installment, the number of possible room layouts has increased considerably, including variations on bath tubs, front yard designs and floor tiles. You can even set up a table on your terrace, which is something that every house should have.

You can play the game in a "My Home wo Tsukurou!" mode of play, where you're free to design a room to your liking, but the big addition for the sequel is the "Takumi Ni Narou!" mode. In this mode, you take on requests from customers in need of design help. You select from a number of clients, each of whom has specific requirements for their home. Some want you to design a new home from scratch, while others want a remodeling. Each client has a desired price range for the work, with your goal being to get into the price range while getting high marks during the evaluation phase at the end of the project.

441550.overview: My Home o Tsukurou 2: Juujitsu! Kantan Sekkei!! (マイホームをつくろう2 充実!簡単設計!!) is a Japan-exclusive home design and construction simulation game released for the PlayStation 2. Because it is a niche, utility-based simulation software rather than a mainstream game, exact direct captures of the boot-up title screen are exceptionally rare online.

441552.overview: Mystereet: Yasogami Kaoru no Jiken File: Become Yasogami Kaoru, the youngest class A detective in IDLA, an international detective organization, and solve difficult cases that baffle veteran policemen. Although the game is split into episodes, the plot lines are interconnected and the web of relationships are so intricate that it is a real challenge to find the culprit and his or her motives.

441554.overview: The game again is a simulation game in which the player can create a home of their own, setting up room layouts on a grid using a simple input system (choosing different bath tubs, front yard designs or floor tiles), the player is free to design each room to their liking. There are different modes, in one the player can design from the beginning, selecting the building site, place and the walls, etc. In other the game offers the player already designed houses and he can modify them or just take a walk around, etc.

448245.overview:
Murasaki no Honoo: The game tells the story of the young heir that was studying in the United Kingdom and have to return home to take care of his inheritance as the owner of the Takatsukasa Heavy Industries. The game as usual in this kind of visual novels features different endings depending of the player choices during the game. As a curious feature the game also allows "Tarot divination" in one day if certain conditions are met.

The Limited Edition features a bonus CD.

448246.overview:
Myself Yourself is set in 2007 in the fictional town Sakuranomori in W Prefecture which is modeled after Wakayama Prefecture, Japan. The town is in a quiet, rural area on the southern tip of the prefecture and borders the Pacific Ocean. Sakuranomori is the birthplace of Sana Hidaka, a sixteen-year-old high school student, who grew up with his childhood friends Nanaka Yatsushiro & Aoi Oribe, his best male friend Shusuke Wakatsuki, and Shusuke's twin sister Shuri Wakatsuki. Sana left Sakuranomori when he was eleven years old, but returns five years later living on his own in the apartment building Aoi's family runs. Sana soon finds out that while some things have stayed the same, there are still just as many things that have changed.

Myselft Yourself: The game is published by Regista which mainly ports all-age versions of adult games developed by other companies, but in 2006 developed and published their first original game called I/O; Myself ; Yourself is the second time Regista has published an original title. Character design for the game is provided by Mutsumi Sasaki, who also did the original character design for Memories Off, Chaos;Head, Happy Lesson, and Futakoi. Unlike most visual novels, Myself ; Yourself has two male protagonists.

The Limited Edition features a Includes a special premium soundtrack and an illustration book "Shiawase no Aoi Tori".

448779.overview: Mahou no Pumpkin: Ann to Greg no Daibouken (魔法のパンプキン　～アンとグレッグの大冒険～) is a Platformer 3D video game published by MTO released on June 19th, 2003 for the PlayStation 2.

448781.overview: Kyo-no Wanko is a Simulation game, developed by Infinity and published by DigiCube, which was released in Japan in 2003.

448783.overview: Gundam True Odyssey: Ushinawareta G no Densetsu (ガンダム・トゥルー・オデッセイ　～失われしＧの伝説～) is a RPG video game published by Bandai released on June 30th, 2005 for the PlayStation 2.

448803.overview:
Mobile Suit Gundam follows the exploits of Amuro Ray and his friends and colleagues aboard the White Base, a flying fortress that serves as their home, as they engage in various missions against the Principality of Zeon. Half a century has passed since the world's population began migrating to massive orbiting space colonies. All is not well, however, as a group of colonies furthest from the planet proclaims itself the Principality of Zeon and declares war on Earth.

Half of the warring factions' populations have been destroyed and there appears to be no end in sight to this war between the Earth Federation and the Principality. An innocent civilian by the name of Amuro Ray is drawn into the conflict, and it's this young man, more specifically, his Gundam, that players control. Based upon the anime, gameplay in Mobile Suit Gundam is reminiscent of Armored Core 2, requiring players to pilot the robot-like Gundam through a number of missions ranging from guerilla attacks on enemy installations to defending a base against an onslaught of invaders.

Before each mission, players can choose to equip their Gundam with various weapons such as a long-range laser rifle and a Beam Saber for melee attacks. The GunTank and GunCannon can be called upon to provide backup in some of the game scenarios. Should the need arise in close-combat, the player can perform various slash attacks with the Beam Saber by pressing a combination of directions and buttons. Animated cut-scenes further the story and provide some insight into the actions and motivations of the many characters.

A Gallery mode contains information and 3D models of the various Mobile Suits encountered in the game as well as in-game cut-scenes and trailers for many of the home videos available in the cartoon series.

466593.overview:
This is a game patch for Madden 08 on PS2 that updates the game database to include the latest rosters, coaches, stadium names, franchise information like salary cap, contracts, and more! This also modifies the game to take in NCAA Football 06 files instead of NCAA 08. This allows users to use NCAA 06 NEXT mod with this game!

In addition TEXTURES for Teams, Uniforms, Fields, Menu UI, and more have been updated with the use of PCSX2 1.7+! This creates an realistic and modern game experience for players to enjoy!

466594.overview:
This is a mod for Madden 05 with the following features:

* 2022 Rosters
* Compatible with NCAA 06 NEXT Draft Classes
* Updated 25 Yard Line Touchback Starting Location
* Updated Uniforms and Graphics

479844.overview:
The Original Arcade Trilogy together for the first time in a single package. Mortal Kombat, Mortal Kombat II and Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 in all its glory enhanced

PitufoDark's version is much better optimized and includes Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3 and the special UMK 3 Juggernauts edition.
